hypothesis.h0: Adding semantic claims and signals (condition D) does not raise success at fixed budget above shared task state (condition C).
hypothesis.h1: Condition D raises success at fixed budget by at least 10 percentage points over condition C.

falsification: The semantic coordination layer of condition D is retained only if D's success at fixed budget exceeds C's by at least 10 percentage points over 30 repository tasks x 5 seeds = 150 trials per cell, analysed as a paired difference in proportions on the workload item with a BCa bootstrap 95% interval whose lower bound stays above zero. Below 10 percentage points, the layer is not expanded and C's shared task state becomes the shipped coordination plane. If B matches C within the same 10-point band, shared task state is dropped as well.

conditions.description: isolated parallel workers, merge at end
isolated workers plus shared task state
isolated workers plus semantic claims and signals

workloads: 30 repository tasks from the Gordian workload corpus
population.sampling: paired on the workload item; conditions in randomized order; model, budget, verifier and trial policy held fixed

effect_size.measure: paired difference in proportions on the workload item
effect_size.unit: percentage points, expressed as a proportion

analysis_plan.uncertainty: BCa bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, resampling seed recorded

exclusion_rule: A trial is excluded when the harness crashes before the first dispatch, when the model endpoint returns a transport error on more than 10% of the calls in that trial, or when the workload item's fixture repository fails its own pre-flight test. Excluded trials are retained with their reason and counted in the report. The rule is applied by script before the primary metric is inspected and never by judgement.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: asymmetric tuning of condition D; controlled by the equal per-arm budget of 40 person-hours and 20000000 agent tokens
LLM run-to-run nondeterminism; controlled by temperature 0.0 and the fixed seed list [1,2,3,4,5]
verifier strength drifting between conditions; the verifier is pinned for the whole grid
